prompt: Create a full-length fantasy game soundtrack song for Tombsands: dusk over a sand-buried necropolis, pale cliffs and half-seen tombs. A solemn, ancient theme slowly gathers quiet grandeur as the lost city comes into view, then settles into peace. Wordless choir voices may carry the melody; no lyrics, chanting, speech or spoken words. Memorable melodic theme, natural dynamics and a satisfying ending.
